spans.s: बृह् (I) vi. 1P (pres. बर्हति) to grow, to increase, to expand.With उद्-, to raise up, Bt.xiv.9.
बृह् (II) vi. 6P (pres. बृंहति) To grow, to increase, Bt.iii.49.
बृहत् (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Wide, far extended, दिलीपसूनोः स बृहद्भुजांतरं प्रविश्य R.iii.54; 2. ample, abundant; 3. mighty, powerful; 4. full-grown; 5. high, lofty, देवदारुबृहद्भुजः K.S.vi.51.
बृहत् (II) n. 1. Brahman (n.); 2. the Veda; 3. name of a Sāman, Bg.x.35.
